entries.columnsContract: `resolution_id PK, query_contract, query_schema_ref, query_input_digest, fact_kind, revision, record_set_digest, rule_revision, rule_digest, result_kind, winning_perception_id NULL, reason_code NULL, result_schema_ref, result_json, result_digest, resolved_at_ms`

entries.columnsContract: `person_id PK, library_kind(normal|jav|us_adult), status(active|merged), current_revision, current_preference_revision NULL, current_reference_revision NULL, current_reference_projection_revision, current_reference_projection_digest, created_at_ms, terminal_at_ms`
entries.constraintsContract: `current_revision`显式复合FK引用`people_person_revisions`；nullable Preference/Reference pointer分别显式复合FK引用对应revision表；`current_reference_revision IS NULL`表示尚无Reference revision，Commit逻辑expected `0`映射为“期望不存在”而不是存储revision 0；两个Projection checkpoint字段均`NOT NULL`，`CHECK(current_reference_projection_revision>=1)`且digest为64位lowercase hex；Person成立时以revision `1`和无Reference语义payload的digest初始化；与child表的循环FK均`DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED`；`INDEX(library_kind,status,person_id)`

entries.columnsContract: `operation_id PK, person_id, actor_id, idempotency_key, request_digest, payload_schema_ref, payload_json, payload_digest, state(preparing|completed|failed), result_schema_ref NULL, result_json NULL, result_digest NULL, failure_code NULL, created_at_ms, updated_at_ms`
entries.constraintsContract: `UNIQUE(actor_id,idempotency_key)`；`INDEX(state,operation_id)`；payload schema固定`people.image-operation-request@1`，closed字段`schema,operationKind(registration|reference_add),expectedPersonRevision,expectedReferenceRevision,operationId,personId,actorId,canonicalName,aliases,selectedImage,faceModelRef`，≤`16 KiB`并完整JCS digest；registration的person_id为未发布身份的预分配ID；reference_add指向已发布Person并冻结两项expected revision，不能FK或由operation自身当作Person事实；state仅从preparing执行terminal CAS；completed schema固定`people.image-operation-result@1`，closed结果`personId,personRevision,referenceRevision`，≤`16 KiB`；failed保存明确错误码且无result；只有内部工作流及用户本次operation只读查询可见，不构成确认队列
